name: Work Handoff
scope: Create durable Task obligations against Case with authenticated owner, freshness preconditions and user-mode DML.

requirements.acceptance: Required obligations survive serialization without relying on free-text summaries.
requirements.coverage: Case-linked Task stores bounded obligation, due date, source modification and authenticated owner.
requirements.blocker: Full completed work/open questions/evidence work-packet schema not implemented.

requirements.acceptance: Stale or missing evidence is visible before a decision.
requirements.coverage: User-mode current Case LastModifiedDate compared against expected stamp before creating Task.
requirements.blocker: Concurrent writes are not locked; later packet-open freshness checks absent.

requirements.acceptance: Work cannot silently become ownerless during transfer.
requirements.coverage: Task OwnerId explicitly set to current authenticated user; invalid/stale requests hold.
requirements.blocker: Human accept/reject/reassign UI and authenticated role transitions not implemented.

requirements.acceptance: Previously completed actions are not repeated and obsolete decisions do not execute.
requirements.coverage: Duplicate Case in same bulk request refused and stale Case does not create obligation.
requirements.blocker: No cross-transaction idempotency or authorized runtime checkpoint resumption.

requirements.acceptance: Unknown fields/capabilities are rejected or explicitly downgraded, not discarded silently.
requirements.coverage: Native tests specify durable Task link/ownership, duplicate and stale holds.
requirements.blocker: Second process configuration and runtime adapter interoperability pending.

blockers: Scoped metadata compilation and unit tests passed; broader integration, denied-user scenarios, actual domain policies and independent evaluation remain incomplete.
Original acceptance requirements remain partial; owner validation, comparative benchmarks and independent evidence pending.
Caller owns new Tasks; cross-transaction idempotency, concurrency locking, authenticated accept/reassign UI and native resumption not implemented.
commands: sf project deploy start --dry-run --target-org eb1a-dev --manifest manifest/package.xml --test-level RunSpecifiedTests --tests CaseHandoffActionTest

native_validation.scope: one Developer org; scoped unit tests and supplied metadata only
